name: Australis class — 2030 concept
hull_deck_join: upper hull shares the full flight-deck underside perimeter
bow_shape: high continuous flared topsides with a narrowing faceted lower bow and fine waterline stem; hydrodynamics unverified

islands.main: larger integrated command and sensor island amidships
islands.aft: 20% narrower, 35% shorter and 28% lower aft aviation island, with glazing on all six bridge faces

deck.aft_spot_use: Helicopter/VTOL operations ahead of the islands; bow catapults remain available, recovery remains separate
deck.aft_spot_layout: Two offset pairs ahead of the islands; forward pair interlocked with waist launch lanes only
deck.lift_reference_aircraft: Stock F-14A; full-span footprint and stock deck-reference offset
deck.layout: Three straight bow catapults and two angled port-waist catapults
deck.catapult_visual_details: Deck-flush metal tracks, thin dark slots and painted guides, compact launch shuttles and flush segmented stowed deflectors; static geometry

systems_visual_studies.radar_placement: conformal panels on the sides and faces of both islands
systems_visual_studies.laser_default_state: flush armoured deck hatches; raised visual state in the viewer and a separate OBJ overlay
systems_visual_studies.ford_zumwalt_derived_fit: Original geometry and declared stock-compatible game proxies; see DESIGN-BASIS.md
systems_visual_studies.vls_and_missile_launchers: Four VLS banks and four defensive missile housings on the marked main-deck edge positions

integration.game_scale_copy: approximate based on an observed reference mesh
